userResume.title: User Resume Profile
userResume.description: User profile and extracted resume data saved to user account

userId.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the user

email.description: The user's Google account email address

displayName.description: User's display name or candidate name

photoURL.description: User profile avatar URL from Google account

fileName.description: Original file name of the uploaded resume

rawText.description: Full extracted plain text of the resume

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the resume was saved

appliedJob.title: Applied Job
appliedJob.description: Tracking of job application status for a specific opening

userId.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the candidate

jobId.description: Unique identifier of the job opening

matchScore.description: Calculated match percentage at time of application

appliedAt.description: ISO timestamp when marked as applied

notes.description: Candidate notes on application or referral

/users/{userId}.description: Private candidate resume and user profile data

/users/{userId}/appliedJobs/{jobId}.description: Jobs marked as applied for by the authenticated candidate
